notes: MultiKernelBench AscendC direct-launch backend. The solver emits ONE JSON submission (sources[]=ModelNew.py + __aicore__ kernel .cpp + pybind11.cpp; entry.model='ModelNew.py::ModelNew'), not a single source file. build.sh validates that contract structurally; the real bisheng+cmake compile, NPU-event timing and correctness all happen inside MultiKernelBench's eval_single_runner.py, which run.sh delegates to (compile/run are coupled there, JIT-like, so artifact_ext is empty). On a host without torch_npu/CANN (e.g. macOS dev box) run.sh and profile.sh degrade honestly (deferred NPU tier). occupancy is intentionally absent (NPU has no warp-occupancy notion) so latency_occupancy is not a declared class. threshold_profile='ascend' is added to _substrate/diagnose.py PROFILES.
